title: if expressions chain else if
purpose: An else-if chain in expression position is one value; each link has its else and every branch one type.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text; reversed by #257
provenance.expected_basis: grammar: if_expr = "if" expr block "else" (if_expr | block); spec 8.11: an else-if chain is an expression.
